summary: Tested the two new features: (1) xlsx-only bulk member import and (2) editable card-back design + web text. Backend: 8 pytest tests covering GET /api/settings exposes card_back_title/rules/web with defaults and persists via PUT; empty web persists; template.xlsx has headers nama,nis,kelas and is 403 for siswa; CSV upload to /api/members/import -> 400 with Indonesian message mentioning Excel/.xlsx; valid xlsx import inserts members and numeric NIS cells (99092/99093 as floats) are stored as plain string without '.0'; siswa POST import -> 403. All 8/8 passed. Frontend: Admin login OK. Impor modal shows 'Excel (.xlsx)' copy; download-template-button downloads 'template-anggota.xlsx'; selecting a .csv is rejected client-side (toast + label resets, no file set); uploading a prepared xlsx with 2 TEST_ rows shows import-result 'Berhasil: 2 · Dilewati: 0 · Total baris: 2' and list refreshes to 5 members. member-card-side-switch toggles front/back; back shows card-back-title, 6 numbered rules (one per \n), and card-back-web. CardDesigner (design-card-button): designer-side-belakang shows designer-card-back; typing in card-back-title-input / card-back-rules-input / card-back-web-input live-updates preview (title 'TEST ATURAN FE', 3 rules, web 'test-fe.sch.id'); save-card-design-button persists and after reload the back card displays the saved text; emptying card-back-web-input hides card-back-web in preview; preset buttons restyle the back card (class includes theme-/font-/size-/layout-). BulkCardPrint: bulk-side-select='belakang' renders 5 bulk-card-back-<id> items and shows bulk-back-hint; switching back to 'depan' removes bulk-card-back-* and renders normal cards. Defaults restored at end; TEST_FE members cleaned up via API.
Completed testing for admin name update ('Devi Latifa, S.I.Pust') and member import Excel feature (.xlsx only). All backend APIs and frontend UI tests passed successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py _parse_member_rows uses str(int(c)) only when isinstance(c, float) and c.is_integer(); if NIS cell is formatted as integer in some templates openpyxl may still return it as int which already stringifies cleanly - current logic covers both. Consider explicitly handling very large NIS stored as scientific-notation floats (>1e16) which would overflow int conversion.
/api/members/import performs insert_many without transaction; partial failure (e.g., duplicate within batch) is already caught pre-insert, OK.
CardDesigner.js draft is initialized from settings but DEFAULT_SETTINGS spread first; if backend adds future card_back_* fields they'll show defaults correctly. Good.
MemberCardBack splits on \n then trims+filters empty — blank lines are collapsed; current behavior desired for 'one line = one rule'.
seed_data_creation: Imported 2 members (TEST_FEOne 99101, TEST_FETwo 99102) via UI then deleted them via /api/members DELETE at end. Settings temporarily changed (card_back_title/rules/web) then restored to original defaults.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration-9 features working. test_iteration9.py builds xlsx in-memory with openpyxl (installed in backend venv). For UI tests, prebuild xlsx via /root/.venv/bin/python since node-side playwright env lacks openpyxl.
